attchmntText: Tamilnadu Telecommunication Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Tamilnadu Telecommunications Limited filed its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a net loss of 4,49,230 hundreds of rupees for the quarter. For the year-to-date period from 1st April 2026 to 30th September 2026, the net loss was 7,90,566 hundreds of rupees. Total income from operations was 250 hundreds of rupees for the quarter. Earnings per share were negative 0.98 rupees for the quarter. Paid-up equity share capital remained at 45,67,620. The Managing Director is J. Ramesh Kannan with DIN 09292181. The results were published in the Business Standard and Murasu newspapers. The filing date was 14th November 2026.

attchmntText: Tamilnadu Telecommunication Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Unaudited Financial Result for the Quarter Ended on 30.09.2026".
voiceSummary: Tamilnadu Telecommunications Limited held a Board Meeting on 13th November 2026 to adopt unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a net loss of 4,49,230 hundreds of rupees for the quarter. This compares to a loss of 3,41,336 hundreds of rupees in the previous quarter ended 30th June 2026, and a loss of 4,29,823 hundreds of rupees for the same period in the previous year. Total income from operations was 250 hundreds of rupees. Year-to-date figures from 1st April 2026 to 30th September 2026 show a net loss of 7,90,566 hundreds of rupees. Basic and diluted earnings per share were 0.98 rupees. Paid-up equity share capital remains at 45,67,620 shares. The financial statements are Ind AS compliant and reviewed.

attchmntText: Pfa outcome of Board meeting dated 13.09.2026
voiceSummary: Tamilnadu Telecommunications Limited has approved the un-audited financial results for the second quarter ended 30.09.2026. The Board of Directors held a meeting on 13.11.2026 at 11.30 a.m. to approve these results. The company filed this information with the National Stock Exchange and Bombay Stock Exchange under Regulation 33 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The Managing Director, J Ramesh Kannan, with DIN 0929218, signed the communication. The scrip codes are TNTELE for the NSE and 523419 for the BSE. The announcement includes the duly authenticated statement of the un-audited financial results in the SEBI prescribed format.
